program.name: Athletic Legs Plus
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: The athletic lower body: hops and calves, then bounds, hips and inner thighs.
program.about: The parts of the legs that make an athlete fast and robust. One day pairs hops with calf and shin strength; the other bounds with hip and inner-thigh strength. Balance work closes each day. Fewer pulled calves and groins, more spring. Both later levels add reps.
